class.name: UltralightBinding
class.brief_description: Revocable export owned by one document.
class.description: Call close to revoke the exported function or object and its nested proxies. Dropping this reference does not automatically revoke the export. Closing a replaced binding never removes its replacement.

method.name: close
method.description: Revoke the export and its nested proxies. Idempotent.

method.name: is_closed
method.description: Return whether the binding was revoked or its document has expired.
